title: Raise one demand at a time
statement: Raise one demand at a time: bring in a harder text only once its reading move is known, and withdraw supports singly, so a failed check points to one change.
example: One course plans its texts to climb from 740 to 940 on a text-difficulty scale, within units as well as across them, so a harder text never arrives with a new move.
detail: The Grade 4 course rationale has text difficulty climb inside a unit as well as across the course, so the harder text arrives after the reading move is known and never at the same time (`othello-course-renderer-draft/repo/content/course-rationale.json`, line 17); its climb, 740L to 940L, is a set of authoring targets rather than measurements (line 13). A research brief applied the rule when sizing a lesson's second passage, since doubling it would add reading load at the same time as a new reading move (`othello-course-renderer-draft/repo/docs/research/g4-u1-l3-circe-and-the-lotus-eaters.md`, lines 446-448). A Grade 3 writing scaffold keeps its two fades in step, so a child is never asked to find evidence unaided and organise the essay unaided in the same jump (`othello-course-renderer-draft/repo/docs/extras/alpharead-writing-scaffold-overview.md`, line 31).
against: It is a design rule, not a measured result, and the source is another course's design ("Not our course.", `grade3-reading/course-renderer/docs/extras/alpharead-writing-scaffold-overview.md`, line 12). The plan under review used the nine-dimension fade dial (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g2-reading/analysis/skeleton-v2.md`, lines 133-134), and a grade-3 synthesis dropped a permanent picture wrapper because an engagement scaffold "must fade to cold plain text or it teaches dependency" (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/handoff/timeback-course-explorer/brainlift/amalgamation-v2.md`, line 289).

how much of the frame is *pre-filled* shrinks — full echo → clause starter → bare stem → blank box (entry 5) — and how much help the child gets *finding the evidence* shrinks — passage shown → region only → nothing (entry 2).

Fading nine dimensions (illustration → cast → tone → audio → schema-load → length → syntax → inference → topic-predictability) simultaneously means that when a Band-B student fails the sequence gate, you cannot tell *which* faded support caused it.
as an *automated* per-student adaptation it is too many confounded knobs for a population this young and a signal this noisy.

picture support is a legitimate comprehension scaffold at this age (dual-coding; the picture-walk tradition), and fading it as if it were decoration may remove a real comprehension support, not just training wheels.
